questions.content: The committee decided to ______ the outdated regulation.
questions.explanation: abandon 表示放弃/废止；符合题意。

questions.content: Students should ______ what they learn to real problems.
questions.explanation: apply ... to 表示把……应用于。

questions.content: Please ______ the volume so that everyone can hear.
questions.explanation: adjust 表示调节。

questions.content: We need an ______ amount of sleep before the exam.
questions.explanation: adequate 表示足够的。

questions.content: Hard work will help you ______ your goals.
questions.explanation: achieve goals 为固定搭配。

questions.content: Children ______ language naturally from their environment.
questions.explanation: acquire language 表示习得语言。

questions.content: The instruction is too ______ to follow.
questions.explanation: ambiguous 表示含糊不清。

questions.content: ______ your weak points before the mock exam.
questions.explanation: assess 表示评估。

questions.content: By the time we arrived, the meeting ______.
questions.explanation: 过去的过去用过去完成时。

questions.content: The book ______ by a young author last year.
questions.explanation: 被动语态：was/were + 过去分词。

questions.content: ______ hard, he still failed the first mock exam.
questions.explanation: 现在分词作状语表示伴随/让步语境中的动作。

questions.content: It is important ______ every day.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do。

questions.content: If I ______ more time, I would practice listening longer.
questions.explanation: 虚拟语气：与现在事实相反，if + 过去式。

questions.content: Not only ______ vocabulary, but he also practiced writing.
questions.explanation: Not only 置于句首时部分倒装。

questions.content: According to the passage idea: Many students improve CET scores mainly because they review wrong answers weekly. What is the main reason for improvement?
questions.explanation: 主旨与因果：错题周复盘。

questions.content: The author says spaced repetition works better than cramming. Which statement is true?
questions.explanation: 细节理解：间隔复习优于临时抱佛脚。

questions.content: In the sentence “The instruction is ambiguous,” the word ambiguous is closest to ______.
questions.explanation: 词义猜测：ambiguous ≈ unclear。

questions.content: If a student only practices easy questions, what can we infer?
questions.explanation: 推理判断：只练简单题会掩盖弱项。

questions.content: The passage suggests allocating time for each CET section. The best strategy is to ______.
questions.explanation: 应试策略：分卷分配时间。

questions.content: Which title best fits a passage about building vocabulary with notebooks and review plans?
options: A Practical Way to Learn CET Words
questions.explanation: 主旨标题匹配。

questions.content: [Conversation] W: Did you finish the listening homework? M: Not yet, I will do it after dinner. Q: What will the man do after dinner?
questions.explanation: 细节：晚饭后做听力作业。

questions.content: [Conversation] M: The library closes at 10. W: Then let's go now. Q: Why do they leave now?
questions.explanation: 因果：图书馆即将关闭。

questions.content: [Lecture] The professor says previewing questions before listening helps catch key words. What does the professor recommend?
questions.explanation: 主旨建议：先看题。

questions.content: [Conversation] W: I am nervous about CET-4. M: Take a mock exam this weekend. Q: What does the man suggest?
questions.explanation: 建议题：周末模考。

questions.content: [Lecture] According to the talk, shadowing means repeating after the speaker with little delay. What is shadowing?
questions.explanation: 定义细节。

questions.content: [Conversation] M: Can you lend me your vocabulary notebook? W: Sure, but return it before Friday. Q: What is the condition?
questions.explanation: 条件细节。

questions.content: 请将下列句子译成英文：坚持每天复习错题有助于提高四级成绩。
questions.correct_answer: Reviewing wrong answers every day helps improve CET-4 scores.
questions.explanation: 注意动名词作主语与 help do/to do。

questions.content: 请将下列句子译成英文：图书馆是学生准备考试的理想场所。
questions.correct_answer: The library is an ideal place for students to prepare for exams.
questions.explanation: place for sb to do。

questions.content: 请将下列句子译成英文：与其临时抱佛脚，不如制定长期学习计划。
questions.correct_answer: Rather than cramming at the last minute, it is better to make a long-term study plan.
questions.explanation: rather than / it is better to。

questions.content: 请将下列句子译成英文：合理分配时间是通过四级的关键。
questions.correct_answer: Allocating time reasonably is the key to passing CET-4.
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语；the key to + doing/n。

questions.content: Write a short essay on the topic: The Importance of Reviewing Wrong Answers. You should write at least 120 words.
questions.explanation: 按议论文框架：观点-理由-例子-结论。

questions.content: Write an essay on: How to Prepare for CET-4 Listening. At least 120 words.
questions.explanation: 可写预习题目、精听、跟读与复盘。

questions.content: Write an essay on: My Plan for College English Study. At least 120 words.
questions.explanation: 计划类作文：目标、步骤、坚持。

questions.content: Write an essay on: Is Online Learning Helpful for CET Preparation? At least 120 words.
questions.explanation: 利弊或立场类写作。
